what: Token counts of draft schemas for the six general chat tools other than finish. One compact JSON object per line in draft-tools.jsonl.
method: Each line was tokenized with the selected model pack's tokenizer through the app's text frontend, using the probe retained in integration/evidence/2026-11-18-chat-tool-schema-tokens. CPU only. No model was loaded.
limits: Drafts only. The shipped schemas, the instructions and the function index are measured in phase 7 of the plan.
